prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence is still thin for single-test change kinds (adoption layout, choose_path hint, choose_path layout, finish copy, home layout, sign_in incentive, sign_in layout).
Redesigning adoption screens (adoption redesign) and adding hints to sign-in (sign_in hint) were helpful, producing multiple winning tests.
Adding waiting info (home wait_info) and notifications (home notification) were helpful, each delivering a winning test.
Copy revisions on path selection (choose_path copy) and adding new screens at the finish step (finish new_screen) consistently hurt performance.
Finish screen hints, home redesigns, and home hints consistently showed no clear effect.
Predictions were generally too high overall, but were too low for several surprising late-stage layout wins.

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Carousel layout redesign for photo upload screen: Redesign the photo upload step into a carousel layout displaying sample photo uploads and live pet style previews. (why: Adoption step takes median 89s / mean 1017s, and 3 emails reported photo pet generation issues. Adoption redesigns have consistently delivered winning tests.)
1: [home, wait_info] Desktop system tray readiness indicator on waiting screen: Display a system tray setup checklist component on the waiting screen while desktop overlays prepare. (why: 3 emails cited pets failing to open or show on the desktop, and median waiting time is 201s. Adding waiting screen information is a proven winning strategy.)
2: [finish, redesign] Stage layout redesign for home intro screen: Redesign the home intro finish screen into a staged spotlight layout focusing on desktop launch controls. (why: The finish step has the lowest completion rate (69.9%) and high completion time (median 395s / mean 5815s). Redesigning key screens improves conversion.)
3: [adoption, redesign] List layout redesign for friend selection screen: Redesign the friend selection screen into a structured list layout showing pet personality traits and attributes. (why: Adoption redesigns have a strong track record of success; presenting traits in a list helps users choose faster.)
4: [home, notification] Desktop system notification alert on waiting screen: Add an optional system notification toggle on the waiting screen that alerts users when desktop pet spawning completes. (why: The home waiting step takes a median of 201s and mean of 2336s. Ready notifications are proven to keep users engaged.)
5: [adoption, new_screen] Custom photo review screen before adoption certificate: Insert a new review screen (new_photo_review_step) before generating the adoption certificate to verify custom pet visuals. (why: 3 emails reported custom pet generation failures or unexpected visuals. Confirming pet visuals prevents post-adoption dissatisfaction.)
6: [finish, new_flow] Desktop pet launch and tray controls tutorial flow: Add an interactive tutorial screen (new_controls_guide) after home intro explaining how to summon, hide, and talk to the pet. (why: 3 support emails cited confusion over pet controls and 4 reported post-setup feature misbehavior. Finish conversion is low (69.9%).)
7: [sign_in, redesign] Stage layout redesign for sign-in screen: Redesign the sign-in step using a stage layout to draw focus to quick account authentication. (why: Sign-in mean time is 567s and account restoration issues are common. Stage layout focuses attention on essential sign-in options.)
